description: This file defines the Store class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing store-related operations such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving store data, including associated layouts and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Model class in the Opencart admin module for managing store data, including CRUD operations and related information such as layouts and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Adds a new store to the database, sets up layout and SEO URL routes for the store, and clears relevant cache.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates an existing store's details in the database and clears related cache.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Deletes a store and all its related data, including layouts, SEO URLs, settings, and associated entries across various tables.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information on a specific store by store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches a list of stores, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a store instance with all necessary dependencies, loaded models, configurations, and environment setup.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores available.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Returns the count of stores using a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Returns the count of stores using a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores in a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByInformationId
methods.description: Returns the total count of stores associated with specific information, account, and checkout IDs.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total count of stores associated with a specific order status ID.
